sovereign_country.strategic_role: 海湾阿拉伯国家自贸走廊、外资100%控股与印度洋海运枢纽

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Electronic Medical Record (EMR) Clinical Workflow Software

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman (recommended seat: Muscat Governorate, Muscat commercial registry district)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: codified civil-law-style statutes with Islamic Sharia as the foundational source of legislation under the Basic Law of the State; no binding common-law stare decisis; commercial matters governed by the Commercial Companies Law, ministerial implementing resolutions, and specialized judicial and arbitral fora.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US–Oman Free Trade Agreement (in force 1 January 2009; investment chapter with national treatment, MFN and investor-state dispute settlement)
Oman–United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 1995; in force 1996; continuation under evaluation within the UK–GCC FTA framework)
Oman–Germany Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since the late 1970s)
Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements with the UAE, India, United Kingdom, France, China and over 40 counterpart states across MENA, Europe and Asia
GCC Common Market: intra-GCC establishment, ownership and services freedoms

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree No. 18/2019 (as amended), Article 61 (Single Person Company), Articles 1-15 (Incorporation and Memorandum of Association); Foreign Capital Investment Law, Royal Decree No. 50/2019; Central Bank of Oman capital deposit requirements.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Companies Affairs and Commercial Register Directorate, Sultanate of Oman.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of a Single Person Company (SPC) incorporating the Model Memorandum of Association, filed through the SANAD/Invest in Oman E-Services Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum paid-up share capital of OMR 500 (approx. USD 1,300) for a technology/services SPC; the full capital must be deposited in a licensed commercial bank in Oman and the bank's capital deposit certificate attached to the incorporation file. No separate national escrow account is required for non-regulated activities; 100% foreign ownership is permitted under the Foreign Capital Investment Law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED by the Sole Shareholder and founding directors of [COMPANY] SPC: 1. Subscription to the entire issued share capital set forth in the Memorandum of Association is ratified and accepted; the paid-up capital contributed by the Sole Shareholder is duly acknowledged. 2. The registered office of the Company is adopted as [address], Muscat, Sultanate of Oman. 3. [Name] is appointed General Manager, empowered to represent the Company, execute contracts, open and operate bank accounts, and manage daily affairs under the Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019). 4. The auditor and corporate secretary are engaged, and management is authorized to complete registrations with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP - Commercial Register Directorate, SANAD/Invest in Oman E-Services Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the SANAD e-services portal, select 'Company Name Reservation', and submit three ranked proposed names in transliterated Arabic/English for the SPC legal form. Ensure the name does not conflict with registered trademarks or existing companies and complies with public order naming prohibitions. Pay the nominal reservation fee online and download the Name Reservation Certificate.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form (electronic)
Copy of Shareholder's passport (certified)
Residential/commercial address declaration of the Shareholder
Notarized Power of Attorney if submitted by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file an objection with the Registrar within 15 days or immediately submit alternative names; repeated rejection may require a formal petition to the MoCIIP Name Approval Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Memorandum of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Omani Notary Public / Attorneys-at-Law, followed by MoCIIP attestation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Omani lawyer to draft the Arabic-language Memorandum of Association using the statutory SPC template. Have the Sole Shareholder or the attorney-in-fact sign the MoA before the notary. Attach the bank capital deposit certificate, certified passport copy, and (if applicable) the certified resolution of the corporate parent. Submit the notarized dossier to MoCIIP for electronic attestation.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum of Association (Arabic original)
Bank capital deposit certificate of OMR 500
Certified copy of Shareholder's passport
Parent company board resolution and certificate of incorporation (if corporate shareholder)
Notarized Power of Attorney (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or MoCIIP queries the MoA, correct the flagged clauses (e.g. misstated capital or incorrect activity description) and re-notarize; obtain a police clearance certificate from the Royal Oman Police if a background check is required for the Manager.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Issuance of Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP - Companies Affairs Directorate and Commercial Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the consolidated electronic application through the SANAD portal comprising the notarized MoA, Name Reservation Certificate, capital deposit certificate, and office lease. Pay the official registration fee (approx. OMR 50) and stamp duties online. Upon approval, download the Certificate of Incorporation and the Commercial Registration (CR) Certificate bearing the CR number and unified number (NIF).
required_dossiers: Notarized and attested Memorandum of Association
Name Reservation Certificate
Bank capital deposit certificate
Office lease agreement (Ejari-registered where applicable)
Consent letter of the appointed General Manager
Completed SPC application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond through the portal within 15 working days with amended documents; if the file is suspended, request reactivation from the Companies Affairs Directorate and pay any applicable late/reactivation fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal License and Oman Chamber of Commerce Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality (or respective Governorate Municipality) and Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the municipal operating license ('Baladiya license') for a technology/software office by submitting the CR Certificate, lease contract, and premises layout. Undergo any required site inspection. Consecutively register the company as an OCCI member and pay the annual membership contribution, which is mandatory for import/export and commercial transactions.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration (CR) Certificate
Office lease contract and building ownership document
Passport copies of Shareholder and General Manager
Municipality license application form
OCCI membership application and fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal inspection fails, correct the identified code violations (signage, fire egress, office partitioning) and schedule a re-inspection; for OCCI rejection, rectify the CR data mismatch or pay outstanding fees and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Social Insurance, and Labour Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA); Public Authority for Social Insurance (PASI); Ministry of Labour
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File for the Income Tax Registration Number (TRN) and VAT registration (mandatory if taxable supplies cross OMR 500,000) through the OTA electronic portal. Register the company as an employer with PASI and enroll the General Manager and all employees. Register the establishment with the Ministry of Labour to obtain work permit quotas and the unified registration number required for visa processing.
required_dossiers: CR Certificate and Certificate of Incorporation
Memorandum of Association
Passport and TRN of the General Manager
Bank account details of the company
Employment contracts and salary schedule
Office lease contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OTA rejects the registration due to data mismatch, correct the legal representative details and re-file electronically; if PASI flags the payroll, submit amended salary declarations and obtain a clearance letter from the OTA before re-application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Sectoral Health-Tech Clearance and Cloud/Data Hosting Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Health (MOH) - Department of Health Information Systems, in coordination with the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the EMR SaaS product information dossier, including clinical workflow documentation, data privacy and security controls aligned with Omani health data regulations, and proof of cloud infrastructure residency or hosting arrangement. Obtain the MOH 'no-objection' or service provider license for marketing an EMR system to medical clinics; register the software service with MTCIT if telecommunications infrastructure is involved.
required_dossiers: EMR software functional specification and user manual
Information security policy and HIPAA-equivalent controls description
Cloud hosting agreement and data residency statement
Clinical workflow and data classification documentation
CR Certificate and MOH application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOH queries data residency or privacy safeguards, submit a remediation plan with enhanced data localization measures and re-file; if MTCIT requests additional declaration, provide a compliance statement and undergo a technical audit within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Health (MOH) - Department of Health Information Systems, jointly with the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT) and MoCIIP for IT service classification.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Health Information Systems Service Provider License (Electronic Medical Record Software Operating Permit).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority (formerly Ministry of Environment and Climate Affairs), Sultanate of Oman
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - Registration/Exempt (low-risk digital service). No full EIA study is required for a pure cloud-based EMR SaaS operation; an environmental registration remains advisable if the company installs any physical server infrastructure or leases data-center floor space.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for zero-discharge pure SaaS; for any physical server room: compliance with thermal management and electronic waste disposal standards under Royal Decree No. 114/2001 (Environmental Protection Standards), zero wastewater discharge, and conformity with occupational heat and HVAC limits; all regulated waste must be handled by licensed waste contractors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance certificate from the Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (Royal Oman Police) for office premises; structural load inspection and building code compliance certificate from Muscat Municipality for any server/clinic-adjacent installation; occupational health and safety workplace clearance as per the OSH Law (Royal Decree No. 20/2020) including first-aid readiness, emergency exit signage, and work-station ergonomic compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), operating the Masar electronic tax portal (ota.gov.om)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Single Person Company (SPC), obtain Commercial Registration from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP). Thereafter, register with the Oman Tax Authority through the Masar portal to obtain a Tax Registration Number (TRN). For VAT, register separately under the VAT Law when turnover exceeds the mandatory threshold; the TRN serves as the VAT ID. Non-resident owners may use a local tax representative for registration and compliance filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election is available. An SPC is taxed as an independent juridical person under the Oman Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 28/2009, as amended). No hybrid mismatch election is permitted. VAT registration is optional for taxpayers below the voluntary threshold (OMR 19,250 annual taxable supplies) and mandatory above the compulsory threshold; group VAT registration is available under specific conditions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration: OMR 38,500 annual taxable supplies; voluntary registration: OMR 19,250 annual taxable supplies
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The Oman Tax Authority has not yet enforced a mandatory real-time e-invoicing clearance regime. Taxpayers must issue VAT invoices in a prescribed electronic or paper format and retain records via the Masar platform. A phased e-invoicing framework (Bayan) has been announced, but as of the current reporting period, no API clearance or digital stamping is mandatory for standard B2B/B2C supplies. Export zero-rated supplies must be supported by customs documentation and bank transfer evidence.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A supply of goods or services qualifies for 0% VAT if the supply is exported outside the GCC, provided the goods are removed from Oman within 90 days of the date of supply (or such extended period approved by the Oman Tax Authority). For services, the recipient must be outside the GCC and the benefit of the service must be received outside Oman. The taxpayer must retain documentary proof of export and international payment evidence. The zero rate does not apply to supplies to GCC residents unless the GCC-wide movement provisions are satisfied.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bayani) / Single Administrative Document
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Proof of departure / export certificate from Oman Customs
Bank transfer or Inward Remittance Certificate from an Omani bank
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Oman Tax Authority may conduct post-export audits to verify the physical export, the foreign receipt of payment, and the absence of buyer-side fraud. If the zero rating is improperly claimed (e.g., failure to export within 90 days, missing documentation, or artificial circumvention), the authority retrospectively claws back the VAT, and the taxpayer is liable for the full 5% tax, plus late penalties (monthly penalty of 1% on unpaid tax, up to 12 months), additional fines up to 100% of the tax amount, and possible criminal penalties for deliberate evasion under the VAT Law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) established under the Central Bank of Oman Law, Royal Decree 114/2000
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fully convertible for current account transactions, including profit remittance and dividends, for foreign-owned Single Person Companies. Capital account transactions are liberalised; inward direct investment requires registration under the Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree 50/2002) and CBO balance-of-payments reporting. There is no prior CBO approval requirement for bona fide corporate remittances or service fees. Profit transfers require audited financial statements, tax clearance from the Oman Tax Authority, and repatriation in the original currency or OMR. No dual exchange rate, no surrender requirement, and no differentiated treatment for non-residents exists. The fixed peg of OMR 1 = USD 2.6008 provides FX stability, but banks will perform enhanced due diligence on medical data and software-related cross-border flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio. Exporters may retain receipts in foreign currency accounts at CBO-licensed banks. Banks must report export transactions exceeding OMR 10,000 to the CBO for balance-of-payments statistical purposes. Prudent treasury practice for the EMR SaaS entity is to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days of invoice due date to align with documentary trade standards and to avoid bank-induced unflagged outward remittance scrutiny. The mandatory conversion ratio is effectively 0%; conversion to OMR occurs only when the trade owner opts to settle service obligations in local currency.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Cross-border USD/OMR Operational Account and Capital Account
Operational Account and Foreign Currency Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility as principal treasury rail. Oman does not license offshore Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs); the CBO mandates that all in-country payment and liquidity services be provided by CBO-licensed banks. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Airwallex, Currenxie, Wise Business) cannot open OMR-denominated accounts or onboard the SPC without a locally licensed bank sponsor. Such EMIs may only serve as ancillary disbursement channels for non-OMR transactions outside Oman, and only via their partner bank SWIFT infrastructure. For regulatory compliance and liquidity control, the primary bank relationship must remain with a Tier 1 Oman domestic bank. Legal constraints include CBO Circular BM 1059 on payment services and the requirement for all sanctioned-money flows to be intermediated through a locally supervised entity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Face-to-face verification is mandatory for initial corporate onboarding under CBO AML/CFT guidelines. The directors and ultimate beneficial owners of the foreign-owned SPC must physically appear at the branch for biometric verification and compliance interview, unless the bank approves a remote identified board member who holds a FATF-compliant passport. A notarised power-of-attorney appointing an Omani resident is accepted for account operations but does not negate the need for at least one authorized executive to attend the onboarding interview. E-KYC video verification may reduce the requirement to a single deposit-taking branch visit, but the bank retains the right to require a second in-person visit for the source-of-funds declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Single Person Company ownership by a non-resident software developer with opaque source of initial capital
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered SPC commercial certificate, constitutional deed, UBO registry extract, notarised source-of-wealth affidavit, 12-month shareholder bank statements, independent accountant's certificate proving lawful origin of funds, and shareholder's certified passport copy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border payment flows from a medical EMR SaaS platform involving potentially sensitive health data and overseas data transfers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed client contracts excluding patient PHI, data-processing agreement demonstrating compliance with Oman's data protection and telemedicine regulations, ISO 27001 and HIPAA certifications, technical description of the EMR system, and a copy of the Oman Ministry of Health/CRDC licence for the medical software.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, watchlist, or adverse media hit associated with the foreign shareholder or counterparties in the healthcare technology supply chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative OFAC, EU, UN and Oman CBO sanctions screening results, legal opinion from an Oman-licensed lawyer on non-prohibited relationships, details of ultimate beneficial owners, and a copy of the entity's sanctions compliance manual.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: NACE/ISIC industry mismatch or weak explanation of revenue model for a dual IT-healthcare software entity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Chamber of Commerce activity-code endorsement (ISIC 6201), National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI) registration, detailed business narrative letter, product brochure, executed master subscription agreements, and bank onboarding forms updated to reflect both software and medical workflow sub-codes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For the initial equity injection into the Omani SPC, use SWIFT MT103/MT202 COV to the Capital Escrow Account at Bank Muscat, HSBC Oman, or National Bank of Oman. The wire must carry the purpose code 'FDI' in the payment narrative, reference the CBO Foreign Investment Declaration number, and include the note 'SPC equity contribution' to satisfy anti-money-laundering screening. Beneficiary bank forms should specify the SPC's Commercial Registration and the capital account number. The Omani Single Person Company law does not mandate minimum capital, but banks ordinarily require an initial funding deposit of between OMR 1,000 and OMR 2,500 to activate the account. All inbound funds must trace their origin to identified shareholder bank accounts; any high-risk jurisdiction funding will trigger enhanced due diligence and request for a historical trail.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Service subscription disbursements for the EMR SaaS platform are cleared through SWIFT MT103 transfers against commercial invoices. For physical medical/EHR infrastructure rollouts, use commercial letters of credit issued through the CBO-licensed bank under UCP 600, with SWIFT MT700/MT707 for issuance and amendment. OMR-denominated local settlement occurs via the Oman Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) platform; international USD settlement is effected through New York correspondent banking lines under SWIFT CT-systems. Banks require a standard FX conversion form (e.g., Form 0254) for service payments above OMR 10,000, accompanied by the underlying invoice, service contract, and proof of tax registration. No CBO approval is required for bona fide trade payments.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forward contracts up to 12 months for non-speculative cash-flow hedging of subscription receipts and software-development disbursements
FX swaps for liquidity rollover and OMR/USD working-capital matching with a licensed Omani bank
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (floating-to-fixed) for long-term USD/OMR exposure where there is a documented underlying lease or facility

Onshore NDFs are not permissible due to the pegged OMR exchange regime and CBO prohibition on non-deliverable trading against the OMR; offshore NDFs may be used only with strict evidence of a lawful underlying commercial transaction and with legal opinion confirming enforceability

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registration Annual Renewal (annual return equivalent under Commercial Register Law RD 3/1974 and Commercial Companies Law RD 18/2019)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCI), Commercial Registry via InvestEasy e-portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar anniversary of the original registration date; renewal application must be filed within the 30-day pre-expiry window and completed by the expiry date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal fine of OMR 50; continued non-renewal for more than 6 months leads to suspension of the CR and administrative strike-off; any business activity after expiry is unauthorized.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return and audited financial statements to the Tax Authority (Income Tax Law, Sultani Decree 28/2009, Article 91)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), Tax Return e-filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of the fiscal year end; for a December 31 year-end the deadline is April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 10% of assessed tax (subject to OTA minimum OMR 500 and maximum OMR 10,000), plus 1% monthly interest on unpaid tax; persistent default triggers tax clearance suspension, CR deregistration, and enforcement measures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of audited annual financial statements with the Commercial Registry (Commercial Companies Law RD 18/2019, Article 131)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the financial year end; for a December 31 year-end the deadline is June 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: MOCI-imposed fine for non-deposit; CR renewal, new license issuance, and sponsor/agent clearance are blocked until the audited financial statements are submitted.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and UBO Register Update (Commercial Companies Law RD 18/2019 beneficial ownership provisions)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MOCI, Commercial Registry and Beneficial Ownership Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, embedded in the CR renewal declaration; any change in beneficial ownership must be filed within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to OMR 5,000 and imprisonment for false UBO declarations; cancellation of the CR and disqualification of directors for willful non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) Membership Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI), Muscat Branch
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Co-terminus with the CR renewal cycle; renewal certificate must remain valid for customs, tenders, and trade operations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Chamber delisting and denial of OCCI-issued certificates; annual CR renewal cannot be completed without a valid OCCI membership.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal Business License Renewal (Baladiyah licensing for registered office and operations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Muscat Municipality (or relevant governorate municipality), Business Licensing Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar year license, renewed within the first month of the municipal license year or upon CR renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Municipal license lapse suspends lawful occupation of the registered address; daily fines and administrative closure of premises until renewal is completed.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: VAT periodic returns and annual reconciliation (Value Added Tax Law, Royal Decree 121/2020)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), VAT e-filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly or quarterly based on taxable turnover, due within 30 days after each tax period end; annual reconciliation and annual supplies declaration submitted with the final period of the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed penalty of OMR 500 per unfiled period, increasing for prolonged non-filing, plus 1% monthly interest on outstanding VAT; failure to file blocks tax clearance certificates.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No revenue or size exemption for Omani commercial companies; every Single Person Company (SPC) must appoint an independent auditor registered in Oman and must have its annual financial statements audited and filed with MOCI and the Tax Authority (Commercial Companies Law RD 18/2019, Article 74).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the IASB; financial statements must be prepared in accordance with IFRS and audited in compliance with Oman Standards on Auditing.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SPC must maintain an up-to-date Beneficial Ownership Register, identify every natural person holding or controlling more than 25% of the company, and reconfirm the UBO declaration annually during the CR renewal process; material shareholding transfers and UBO changes must be reported to MOCI within 30 days of the transaction, with annual confirmation of the full shareholder chain attached to the statutory filings.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of General Meetings and Board Resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $400 - $1,200 per year (includes Muscat registered office address, public notary, and PRO/agent service)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $1,500 - $4,000 per year for a small-cap EMR SaaS SPC with standard transaction volume

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: First OMR 30,000 of taxable income is exempt; income above OMR 30,000 is taxed at 15%. No industry-specific software or health-tech deduction is available. Standard deductions apply for payroll, office lease, cloud hosting and amortization of capitalized EMR software development at 33.33% straight-line over 3 years. Special-zone tax holidays exist only for licensed projects inside Duqm SEZ, Sohar FTZ and similar zones, which do not apply to the current urban-registered SPC.
